title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm used to minimize a function by iteratively moving towards the steepest descent direction. It is commonly used in machine learning to find the optimal parameters of a model.

title: Convergence of Gradient Descent
text: For gradient descent to converge to a local minimum, certain conditions must be met, such as a sufficiently small learning rate and a convex loss function.

title: Role of Learning Rate
text: The learning rate determines the size of the steps taken towards the minimum. If the learning rate is too large, the algorithm may overshoot the minimum and fail to converge.

title: Analyzing the Statement
text: Consider the statement: "With an infinite number of updates and a fixed learning rate, gradient descent will always converge to a local minimum." Is this statement true or false?
